fato_historico: 1920: Ray Chapman of the Cleveland Indians is hit on the head by a fastball thrown by Carl Mays of the New York Yankees. Next day, Chapman will become the second player to die from injuries sustained in a Major League Baseball game.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to practice mindful protection of your precious energy. Just as history reminds us how quickly the winds of fortune can shift, it is a good time to cherish the present moment. Consider this an opportunity to anchor yourself in stability and grace, shielding your heart from sudden impacts while remaining open to the gentle rhythm of life.
frase_do_dia: Protect your peace like a four-leaf clover in a vast, wild field.
significado_numero: Represents the path toward inner wisdom and spiritual grounding for you.
conselho: Move slowly through your tasks and prioritize your emotional and physical safety today.
